package_derivation.fixed_instance: n=5 Euclidean rank-3 symmetric tensor; trace-vector slices k=1 and k=2
package_derivation.scope: Exact reconstruction and vanishing trace for two fixed slices. This finite-index replay is diagnostic and is not proof of the symbolic-n STF projector or all 35 independent n=5 components.

sources.citation: V. T. Toth and S. G. Turyshev, Efficient trace-free decomposition of symmetric tensors of arbitrary rank, Int. J. Geom. Methods Mod. Phys. 19 (2022) 2250201, arXiv:2109.11743, doi:10.1142/S0219887822502012.
sources.locator: Eqs. (14)-(16), Sec. 3; general closed form in Eqs. (38)-(40)
